title: Jason Sudeikis Credits Olivia Wilde's Role in Ted Lasso
excerpt:
Sudeikis acknowledged Wilde's early encouragement of the series.
The idea took years to develop into the Apple TV hit.
body_md:
Jason Sudeikis has acknowledged Olivia Wilde's contribution to the development of Ted Lasso during an interview at the Hollywood Bowl in Los Angeles. His comments come years after the former couple experienced a complicated separation.

According to Sudeikis, Wilde followed up on the idea of a television series at a time when he and his collaborators had not yet determined how to develop the character. Sudeikis, Brendan Hunt and Joe Kelly spent time considering the concept before arriving at a fuller set of creative ideas.

The development process extended over several years, during which the former couple's personal circumstances also changed. Sudeikis's acknowledgment separates Wilde's creative encouragement from their subsequent personal disagreements.

The comments do not establish Wilde as an officially credited creator of the series. Rather, they recognize her role in encouraging an idea that eventually became one of Apple TV's best-known productions. The account illustrates how much time can pass between an initial concept and a successful television series.
